architecture.conversion: player conversion shrunk to league conversion
architecture.keeper_save: single shared miss outcome; keeper save probability conditional on a miss
architecture.occurrence: EB blend 50/50 team penalties awarded + opponent penalties conceded, shrunk to league
architecture.scored_penalty_goal_integration: subtract expected scored-penalty mass from team goal lambda, then simulate explicit penalty score; never add on top
architecture.taker: recency-weighted prior penalty attempts within team
